prompt.label: Medium — Contract and Document Analysis
prompt.userMessage: Our procurement and legal teams review hundreds of vendor agreements every quarter, and identifying unusual clauses or inconsistent commercial terms has become increasingly difficult. Important obligations around renewals, pricing adjustments, or compliance requirements are often buried deep within lengthy documents. The current review process is heavily manual and depends on institutional knowledge from a small number of experienced employees. We are looking for a more scalable way to analyze large volumes of business documents and surface key risks or inconsistencies earlier in the process.

rounds.content:
{
  "action": "clarify",
  "round": 1,
  "message": "This could go a few directions. Which is closest to what you want?

A) Clause extraction tool — upload contracts, AI pulls out key terms (renewal dates, pricing, obligations) into a structured table reviewers can scan
B) Risk flagging tool — AI scans contracts and automatically flags unusual or inconsistent clauses for legal review
C) Contract Q&A — reviewers ask questions in plain English ("which contracts auto-renew next quarter?") and get cited answers
D) Review workflow tracker — assign contracts to reviewers, track status and checklists, store findings"
}

parsed.message: I'll build a clause extraction tool where reviewers upload vendor agreements and AI extracts structured terms — renewal dates, pricing adjustments, compliance obligations, and unusual clauses — with citations back to the source. Reviewers can search and filter across all extracted clauses, flag items for follow-up, and receive email notifications when extractions complete or high-risk clauses are detected. Admins get an oversight dashboard and can export data as CSV. All actions are audit-logged.

tasks.summary: Set up storage for users, vendors, uploaded contracts, the structured clauses pulled from them, reviewer annotations, and an audit trail.
tasks.task: Tables: users, vendors, contracts, extracted_clauses, clause_annotations, audit_logs. Indexes on FKs and on extracted_clauses(clause_type, contract_id), audit_logs(created_at DESC). Column-level contract: data_model.

tasks.summary: Set up a semantic search index so reviewers can find clauses by meaning across all extracted contract data.
tasks.task: pgvector extension. Table: doc_chunks(id, contract_id, clause_id NULL, chunk_text TEXT, embedding vector(3072), metadata JSONB). HNSW index on embedding (cosine). Embedding model: text-embedding-3-large via MGA.

tasks.summary: Build the API that accepts contract uploads, runs AI clause extraction, stores structured results, supports search/filter/annotate, sends email alerts, and exports CSV.
tasks.task: Data: pg Pool from env. Endpoints + bodies: api_contract. Behaviors + rules + side-effects: business_logic_contract. Auth: x-amzn-oidc-data JWT sub/email; create users row on first login. File uploads: multer memory storage only — parse PDF/DOCX in-memory, send text to MGA assistant for extraction, persist structured clauses to Postgres and chunk-embeddings to pgvector; do NOT write raw files to disk. Email notifications on extraction-complete and high-risk-clause-detected. CSV export streams extracted_clauses with filters. Admin endpoints require role='admin'. Audit log every write.

tasks.summary: Build the reviewer UI: upload contracts, see extracted clauses in a structured table with source citations, search/filter across clauses, flag and annotate, plus an admin oversight view.
tasks.task: Views + components: ui_contract. Endpoints + body shapes: api_contract (prepend /api/). States: spinner during upload+extraction, empty CTA on no contracts, toast on 4xx/5xx, 404 page, disabled submit during POST, progress indicator while AI extracts. Responsive.

tasks.summary: Wire all services together so the app runs locally with one command.
tasks.task: Wire database, vectordb, backend, frontend. Backend env: DATABASE_HOST=database, DATABASE_PORT=5432, DATABASE_NAME=clauses, DATABASE_USER=clauses_user, DATABASE_PASSWORD=localdev123, VECTORDB_HOST=vectordb, VECTORDB_PORT=5432. nginx.local.conf proxy /api→backend:3000. depends_on chain frontend→backend→{database,vectordb}. Healthchecks. Named volumes for database and vectordb.

triggers.action: create users row from OIDC sub/email, default role='reviewer'

parse PDF/DOCX text in-memory, set status='extracting', invoke MGA extraction assistant, persist extracted_clauses with citations, chunk+embed text into pgvector doc_chunks, set status='complete' and extracted_at=NOW()
send email notification to uploading reviewer with summary of extracted clauses
mark clause risk_level='high', send email alert to uploading reviewer
set extracted_clauses.is_unusual=true based on cross-contract comparison

rules: all endpoints require authenticated user via x-amzn-oidc-data JWT
reviewers can upload contracts and view/annotate any clause across the org
reviewers can only edit/delete their own annotations
raw uploaded file bytes are NEVER persisted to disk — only extracted text and structured clauses stored
all POST/PUT/DELETE write actions write an audit_logs row
side_effects: email notification on extraction complete and on high-risk clause detection
pgvector embeddings written alongside extracted_clauses for semantic search

mga_assistants.name: Clause Extraction Assistant
